summary: The door shim's boolean verbs flip name-for-name. `_Shape.__sub__`/`__add__`/`__and__` and the `fuse`/`cut`/`intersect` methods no longer refuse at the verb: they record a BooleanOp row `{mode, a, b}` and dispatch it through the certified funnel at record time, so a refused pair raises its typed refusal immediately (never a silent fallback). The dispatch is placement-blind (scope decision 2): each operand's LOCAL solid classifies into the facade's carrier taxonomy (box/cylinder/sphere/prism/line-lathe -> canonical, spline-profile lathe -> revolved, loft/sweep -> swept, torus -> torus) and the operand's recorded frame composes after. A routed pair records the certified event `{mode, base, tool}` on the measured facts; a canonical x canonical pair lands on the canonical path (no event); a both-swept pair keeps the typed `NonCanonicalCarrier` refusal and a torus-in-a-swept-pair keeps `ContactReductionDeferred`, both naming the carrier class. Depth-1 only (scope decision 3): a boolean of a boolean result refuses typed naming `BooleanResultOperand` rather than silently recursing. The bridge's tree executor gains the Boolean node, dispatches every row, records the routed events in script order, and measures/meshes the row's base operand. Five named tests green. Admission is unchanged (widened not at all).

implementation.door_recording: corpus/ttc/door.py: `_Shape._boolean(other, mode)` refuses a non-kernel operand, builds the `{mode, a, b}` row through `_boolean_node` (which refuses a depth-2 chain typed naming `BooleanResultOperand`), dispatches it at record time through `_T123D.bd_facts` (so the typed refusal surfaces before the corpus's `repair`/`is_valid_shape` can swallow it), and returns a `_BooleanResult`. `__sub__`/`__add__`/`__and__` map to `subtract`/`union`/`intersect`; `fuse`/`cut`/`intersect` reduce over their tool list. `_BooleanResult` is a `_Shape` carrying the recorded row and delegating all facts to the native executor. Placed operands keep their recorded frame on their own node; the row never rewrites it.
implementation.bridge_and_kernel: truck123d/src/bd_bridge.rs: new `BooleanNode { mode: ModeValue, a, b }` and `TreeNode::Boolean { boolean }` (serde untagged, key `boolean`); `Facts` gains `boolean_events: Vec<SweptBooleanEvent>`. `solid_carrier_class` maps a `SolidSpec` to the facade's `CarrierClass` (local geometry only); `node_carrier_class` refuses a boolean operand typed (depth-1) and classifies a group by its first part; `dispatch_boolean` calls `crate::facade::dispatch_swept_carrier_boolean` and returns the routed `SweptBooleanEvent` or the typed envelope case; `collect_boolean_events` validates every row and collects the events in script order. `count_and_union`, `top_volume`, `top_seam_mismatch` and `append_node_mesh` dispatch a Boolean node and recurse into its base operand (the certified row's measured geometry is its base); `bd_facts` serializes `boolean_events` when non-empty.
implementation.facade: truck123d/src/facade.rs: no change required. The existing admission consult (`dispatch_swept_carrier_boolean`) already routes/refuses the carrier-class pair and returns the certified `CertifiedBooleanRoute` the shim records; the packet's write_allow lists facade.rs but the landed consult is exactly the router this flip consumes.
implementation.kernel_tests: Five tests added in truck123d/src/bd_bridge.rs mod tests: `cut_swept_canonical_certifies_end_to_end` (a ruled loft cut by a box routes; event mode subtract, base swept, tool canonical; the row measures its base), `fuse_swept_swept_certifies_end_to_end` (a ruled loft fused with a spline-profile revolve routes; event mode union, base swept, tool revolved), `intersect_swept_canonical_certifies_end_to_end` (a spline-profile revolve intersected with a box routes; event mode intersect), `placed_operands_transform_to_canonical_before_dispatch` (a placed loft's event carries the LOCAL swept class while the measured world bbox carries the placement), and `refused_pairs_still_refuse_typed_unchanged` (swept x swept -> NonCanonicalCarrier, torus-in-a-swept-pair -> ContactReductionDeferred, canonical x canonical -> no event).
